notes.title: v1.2.0 - Voice Acting and More!
notes.content: [h1][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/671e9b0d678abb0425a971cf/c18325c7-770c-4e13-85e4-425e4aa58c22/export+magazine_Blitzstrike+logo+final.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Hello Blitzstrike fans![/h1][p][b]Blitzstrike[/b] has just received its most immersive update yet! There's quite a bit to unpack, so let's break it down.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW: [/b]Full Voice Acting[/h2][p][b]Blitzstrike[/b] just got a lot more real... with full voice acting for not just the cutscenes, but for Trixel and Vectroia's in-game actions as well! Every scene has been dubbed to evolve [b]Blitzstrike[/b] from a game to a production.[/p][p][/p][h3]Trixel - voiced by Zyra Bisquera[/h3][h3]Vectoria - voiced by Aimee Smith[/h3][h3]The Commander - voiced by D. Tyler Fultz[/h3][p][/p][p]This huge amassment of talent brings Blitzstrike to life in ways never seen before, and their powerful performances makes humor funnier, and tense scenes tense...er. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW: [/b]Vectoria Vision[/h2][p]I've received valuable feedback regarding Vectoria's showdown, how it can be difficult to tell what her next move is, and I am happy to announce a solution: [b]Vectoria Vision! [/b]Now, before Vectoria makes her move, a little icon will flash above her head, showing exactly what she's plotting... and even where she's going! Now achieving the "Flawless" achievement is a little easier.[/p][p][/p][p]Do pay attention and react quickly, because Vectoria waits for no one.[/p][p][/p][p]I am super excited for players, old and new, to experience [b]Blitzstrike[/b] in a brand-new light, and Trixel and Vectoria cannot wait to speak to the hearts of gamers worldwide. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope you continue to enjoy Blitzstrike![/p][p][i]-Brennan[/i][/p][p]#Blitzstrike #indiegame #voiceacting[/p]

notes.title: Blitzstrike - Fan Service (Literally) - Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3654000/extras/BSLogo.png?t=1750986639[/img]

Hey Blitzstrike [b]fan[/b]s!

Blitzstrike has received [b]fan[/b]tastic feedback, but one [b]fan[/b] pointed out a small issue about the... well, [b]fan[/b]s. It was tricky to tell the strength of them. Were they strong? Weak? It was just a [b]fan[/b]tasy-level guess. 

So I made it crystal clear:
The speed of the particles emitted reflect the actual force of the [b]fan[/b]! Now you'll know exactly how much lift to expect- no more surprise skydives. Trixel was not a [b]fan[/b] of those.

It's a [b]fan[/b]cy little fix for our [b]fan[/b]atics out there. Now everything just feels a bit more [b]fan[/b]tastically satisfying.

Okay, I'll stop. Thanks for playing.

[I]-Brennan[/i]

notes.title: 1.1.1 - Bug Fixes + Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3654000/extras/BSLogo.png?t=1750986639[/img]

[h2]Hey Blitzstrike fans![/h2]

Some minor bug fixes have been included into Blitzstrike v1.1.1, providing a smoother gameplay experience. If you're curious, here's an abridged list.

[list]
[*]Trixel and the Commander would sometimes appear invisible in the cutscene preceding [b]Meet Trixel![/b]
[*]The credits can be skipped like any other cutscene now, by pressing ESC or START, depending on what controls you are using.
[*]In [b]You Knew This Was Coming[/b], in rare cases, Vectoria would stand there... and do nothing. Sometimes thats even more scary.
[/list]

Thats all. As thanks for reading this post and loving Blitzstrike, here's Trixel chilling with a cat. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1179608276904710144/1383955465280553071/pixil-frame-0-641_scaled_10x_pngcrushed.png?ex=6867beb7&is=68666d37&hm=9c4b4ec0baa36fbc4763a0f8bfa1bfe0de0ca6da2520a327f186b1f84179e242&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=820&height=1300[/img]

[I]-Brennan[/i]

notes.title: Blitzstrike - v1.1.0 - Speedrun Arena and More!
notes.content: [p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3654000/extras/BSLogo.png?t=1750986639"][/img][/p][h1]Hello Blitzstrike fans![/h1][p][/p][p]Trixel’s got a new mission... and so do you! The first major content update for [b]Blitzstrike[/b] is here, and it’s packed with fresh features to amp up the action and add a splash of retro flair.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW:[/b] Speedrun Arena [/h2][p]Think you’re fast? Prove it.[/p][p]After completing the main campaign and watching the post-credits scene, you’ll unlock the [b]Speedrun Arena[/b], a brand new challenge level designed to put your reflexes (and Trixel’s full moveset) to the test. Dash, jump, and uppercut your way to the exit as fast as possible to earn [b]bronze, silver, gold,[/b] or even the elusive [b]platinum medal.[/b][/p][p]Got a killer time? Show it off using #BlitzstrikeSpeedrunArena![/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW: CRT Filter[/b] [/h2][p]Introducing the [b]CRT Filter[/b], a nostalgic visual effect that wraps [b]Blitzstrike[/b] in a warm, retro glow. Turn it on and you’ll instantly feel like you're playing on an old-school tube TV, complete with scanlines, and chromatic aberration that brings out the charm of its pixel art roots. Whether you’re speedrunning with style or just vibing with Vectoria in a moody rain level, the CRT filter adds a layer of immersion that makes [b]Blitzstrike[/b] feel like a long-lost classic... rediscovered.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]- Adjustments -[/b] [/h2][p]The following adjustments have been made to [b]Blitzstrike[/b], allowing for a smoother gameplay experience:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug regarding the "[b]Where Do You All Keep Coming From?" [/b]achievement where the goal would be reached, but no achievement. This has been fixed, and will unlock immediately upon the next opening. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of enemies in the final section of "Blown Away"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where Trixel will sometimes clip through a wall in Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up Trixel and Vectoria's running animations for a more fluid feel. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rain rendering issue in "Rooftop Rumble" and "Abysswatch"[/p][/*][/list][p]Trixel and Vectoria are beyond stoked with the love and support [b]Blitzstrike[/b] has gotten around the globe. The community’s response has been incredible, and we’re just getting started.[/p][p]I hope you continue to enjoy Blitzstrike![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Brennan[/i][/p][p][/p][p]#Blitzstrike #Trixel #Vectoria #IndieGame[/p]

notes.title: Blitzstrike - Day TWO Patch
notes.content:
You've heard of a Day One patch, bet you've never heard of a day [b][i]TWO[/i][/b] patch!

In addition to small minor internal fixes, some noticeable changes are:

 [list]
[*]Volume is saved alongside accessibility options, so you don't get jumpscared with a loud Blitzstrike [i]beep[/i] every launch.
[*]Fixed a softlock on Level 9. Vectoria slipped that one in there last second.
[/list]
More changes are coming in the future, so stay tuned!

-[I]Brennan[/i]
